layoff.summary: What they really mean: The company is laying off its workforce, reducing costs, and we're cutting jobs.

lines.original: Today I'm sharing some difficult news.
After a thorough review of our priorities, we have made the hard decision to reduce our workforce by approximately 12%, impacting around 340 roles across Product, Sales, and Operations.
This was not a decision we made lightly.
The macroeconomic headwinds we discussed last quarter have persisted, and we need to build a leaner, more focused Corvane that can win in this next chapter.
lines.plain: We're cutting costs, which means fewer people and less money.

lines.original: Impacted colleagues will receive an email from People Operations within the next hour.
Everyone affected will receive a separation package, extended healthcare, and career transition support.
To those leaving us: thank you.
Your contributions shaped who we are, and I am deeply grateful for everything you have given to this journey.
lines.plain: Thank you for your hard work.

lines.original: For those staying, I know this is hard.
We will come out of this stronger, more agile, and better positioned for long-term growth.
lines.plain: Stronger, more agile, and better positioned.

lines.original: I'll share more at Thursday's all-hands.

record-year.summary: What they really mean: Tessaline's strong performance and your dedication have led to our success, so no raises for now.

lines.original: What a year!
I'm incredibly proud to share that Tessaline just closed the strongest year in our history: record revenue, up 31%, and our best operating margin ever.
This happened because of all of you.
Your passion and grit are why we exceeded our targets in every region.
lines.plain: Your enthusiasm and determination are the reason we achieved great success.

lines.original: As we look ahead, we are being prudent.
Given the uncertain macro environment, we have made the decision to pause merit increases for this cycle and to keep our bonus pool at a modest level.
We believe this disciplined approach positions us to keep investing in growth and shareholder value.
lines.plain: This strategy ensures continued growth and shareholder value.

lines.original: I've never been more excited about our future.
The best is yet to come!

corporate.text: I can't attend the meeting, I'm bogged down. This proposal is flawed.
